# Contribution

Use this template when opening a PR that adds a new contribution (code, docs, examples, etc.).

- **Type**: (e.g., code, docs, tests, example)
- **Summary**: Short summary of the contribution.
- **Related issues/PRs**: Link any existing issues or PRs.
- **Implementation details**: Key changes and rationale.
- **Testing**: How was this tested? Any new tests added?
- **Documentation**: Were docs added/updated?

## Checklist
- [ ] Read the CONTRIBUTING.md and followed the guidelines
- [ ] Ran existing tests locally and they pass
- [ ] Added/updated tests where applicable
- [ ] Added/updated documentation if applicable
